manuscript_selection: All source pages are replayed; old page15 maps to solved LP1-15 and is excluded from the unsolved-page global maximum. All other source ordinals map to LP2 by subtracting 17.

source_grid.source_score: normalized IoC + 0.01*source bigram score + 0.05*source trigram hits, evaluated only above gate
source_grid.separator_rule: source extract_runes retains a set of rune counts after each visible separator; several separators at the same position count once, and separators after the last rune do not change output

controls.positive: Before real scoring, encipher the first 250 GP indices of each of the four named archived readings welcome, first-koan, loss-of-divinity, and second-koan under letter shift 7, separator shift 5, source sub direction; place into a predeclared 250-rune layout and require exact recovery and source IoC gate passage for both parsers.
controls.oracle: Compare source alberti_decrypt against the algebraically collapsed two-feature recurrence on source page 28 for representative and seeded settings before full scan.
controls.null: 49 independent seeded (330123) within-page rune-order shuffles per parser, retaining the original separator positions and repeating the complete source grid across all eleven unsolved source pages; save the single best source score per whole search. This is a selection-aware descriptive control, not an encryption model.

interpretation: No result identifies a plaintext or excludes all progressive ciphers. Source's literal rune parser and mixed solved/unsolved target list must be disclosed. The corrected parser is a new bounded adaptation, not an exact historical replay.
